description: Source code for an HTML report generator and reporter class for Playwright test framework, including methods for building, serving, and managing HTML test reports.

classes.name: HtmlReporter
classes.description: Main class implementing the test reporter that generates HTML reports for Playwright tests.

classes.name: HtmlBuilder
classes.description: Helper class responsible for constructing the HTML report, including data collection, file copying, and report finalization.

classes.name: Base64Encoder
classes.description: Stream transformer encoding data to base64, used for embedding zip data into HTML.

methods.name: reportFolderFromEnv
methods.description: Retrieves report folder path from environment variables.

methods.name: getHtmlReportOptionProcessEnv
methods.description: Gets HTML report open option from environment variables.

methods.name: showHTMLReport
methods.description: Serves the HTML report via a local server and optionally opens it in a browser.

methods.name: startHtmlReportServer
methods.description: Creates and starts an HTTP server to serve report files.
